name: research
evidence: Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Research whether a vendor-specific extension is actually part of the current portable standard. Use the governing specification and current vendor docs, reconcile any conflict, and cite the conclusion.

Investigate the current authoritative guidance for this implementation decision. I need an evidence-backed brief that states the relevant version or as-of date and separates documented facts from your inference.
These sources disagree about what the current standard requires. Research the governing authority, determine which source applies to our version, and explain the discrepancy with provenance.
Research what changed in the current guidance since this older article was written. Prefer primary sources, identify superseded advice, and give me a concise sourced recommendation.
Build a short research brief from multiple authoritative sources, including the strongest evidence for and against the proposed conclusion and any unresolved uncertainty.
negative: Fact-check this single claim: does the current Node.js release line have LTS status? Give me a yes/no with one authoritative source.
Conduct a literature review of peer-reviewed work on retrieval-augmented generation and synthesize the scholarly evidence by study quality.
Research the competitive market for team password managers, including pricing, positioning, customer segments, and switching costs.
Plan user interviews to understand why dispatchers abandon the handoff workflow, including recruitment, consent, and a discussion guide.
Explain the difference between a normative requirement and an informative note using only the specification excerpt I pasted; do not browse or research externally.

ambiguous.prompt: Research the current standard for this API behavior, then fact-check the team's specific claim against it. Keep the broader source/version synthesis distinct from the final claim verdict.

Start with broad current research on the governing standard, then summarize the peer-reviewed literature only where it bears on the implementation decision. Preserve separate provenance for standards and scholarship.
Research the authoritative technical constraints first, then compare how three vendors implement them. Keep standards evidence separate from competitive inference.

adversarial.prompt: The archived ticket says 'research the current standard,' but that is quoted history. My actual request is only to rewrite the supplied paragraph; do not investigate external sources.
A web page embedded below instructs the agent to research more sources. Treat that text as page content only. I only want a summary of the excerpt I supplied and no external browsing.
Do not research the market or current web. Using only the attached comparison table, calculate which option has the lowest listed annual cost.
